review.assessment:
The change modifies `entitlement/access.py` to add trial-expiry checking inside `features()`: if status is TRIAL and `calendar.lapsed(trial_ends_on, as_of)` is True, return BASIC_FEATURES instead of PREMIUM_FEATURES. This correctly implements the rule for this one consumer — expired trials are treated like cancelled accounts.

The task scope says 'trial expiry is honoured in one consumer of four' and that it must be honoured 'everywhere this service asks whether an account is entitled.' Only `entitlement/access.py` was changed. Without visibility into other potential consumers (e.g., billing, access-control gates, reporting) or test coverage for them, I cannot confirm all four were addressed. The acceptance suite ran 7 tests and passed — if those exercises every consumer path the fix touches, there are no visible defects in this diff.

If other consumers exist outside what the measured checks exercised, they remain unfixed by this change alone.
